images.title: The saree border
images.purpose: Show a border repeating A, B, C and the positions where C falls, the multiples of 3.
images.composition: One horizontal strip of 9 cells across the middle with position numbers underneath; white space above and below.
exact_structure: One horizontal strip of exactly 9 equal square cells in a row, outlined in #2B2B2B.
From left to right the cells hold the letters A, B, C, A, B, C, A, B, C; every A cell is filled light teal #0072B2, every B cell light amber #E69F00, and every C cell light reddish purple #CC79A7.
Under each cell its position number in #1F2937: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.
Below the numbers, one centred caption "C at 3, 6, 9" with short grey #6B7280 tick lines joining it to the numbers 3, 6 and 9 only.
No other designs, no numbers beyond 9.
rejection: a strip of other than 9 cells
letters not in the order A B C repeated
C placed at any position other than 3, 6 and 9
images.takeaway: Design C sits at 3, 6, 9, the multiples of 3, so the nth C is at position 3n.
images.description: A strip of nine cells A B C repeated three times with positions 1 to 9 and the C cells at 3, 6 and 9.
images.context: Shown beside the saree border text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Find all the C cells first and read their position numbers aloud.

image_decisions.why: The numbered strip lets students see the multiples of 3 before writing 3n.
